defect_found.consequence: two parsers disagreed about the same wire data; the name check could run on a chain the digest step refused
defect_found.description: _names read only the first length-prefixed element, so a leaf followed by a truncated or non-DER element still produced enforced names while _chain_digests rejected the same bundle
defect_found.fix: _chain_blobs walks every element, requires the DER SEQUENCE tag and checks that each declared element length matches its header exactly

notes: a real CA-issued certificate still parses: 728-byte DER yields the same two names
the digest path and the name path now reject the same malformed bundles
